يعتطفوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَطِفُوا (yaʕtaṭifū) /jaʕ.ta.tˤi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# يُعْتَطَفُوا (yuʕtaṭafū) /juʕ.ta.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
